title: Job search
signed_out_body: Feeds and your pasted vacancies stay on this account.
empty_body: Missing pay and sponsorship stay not stated. A pasted vacancy is only yours.
no_results_body: Try another search, or paste the vacancy.
paste_url: Link to the original, if you have one
stale_title: This listing has not been checked recently
stale_body: The saved text is still here. Open the original listing to confirm it.
missing_title: That listing is not in FlacronCV
radius: This plan searches up to {limit} miles.
compare_body: {count, plural, one {# resume analysis remaining} other {# resume analyses remaining}}. This compares the listing with your resume. It is not a hiring probability.
compare_no_resume: Create a resume first. No analysis was used.
compare_quota: No resume analyses left. The listing is still here.
compare_not_a_score: This is not an employer score and it is not a hiring probability.
fit_none: No overlap with your confirmed facts
fit_partial: Partial overlap with your confirmed facts
fit_strong: Strong overlap with your confirmed facts
gap_word: In the listing, not in your confirmed facts: {token}.
unknown_unconfirmed: {token} is only on a fact you have not confirmed.
trust_disclaimer: These checks show freshness, conflicts, and reports. They do not promise a listing is safe.
trust_none: No extra warnings on the saved text. That is not a promise the listing is safe.
trust_confidence_candidate: Source: text you pasted. FlacronCV did not collect this from an employer feed.
trust_confidence_provider: Source: a job-feed record. The feed is not a safety check.
trust_confidence_multiple: Matched across {count, plural, one {# source} other {# sources}}. A match is not a safety check.
trust_expired: The saved status says this listing is expired.
signal_verified_employer: A moderator confirmed this posting. That does not promise the role is open or safe.
signal_stale_listing: Last checked more than 14 days ago. The employer site may have changed.
signal_suspicious_fee: The text mentions an upfront fee or payment. Check the original listing before you apply.
signal_conflicting_compensation: The saved pay range conflicts with itself: the minimum is higher than the maximum.
signal_duplicate_sources: This listing was matched across {count, plural, one {# source} other {# sources}}.
signal_user_flagged: {count, plural, one {# open report is} other {# open reports are}} waiting for review. This is not a confirmed finding.
report_hint: One open report per person. Sending again updates that report.
report_pending: Your report is waiting for review.
report_reviewed_dismiss: A reviewer looked at your report. The listing stays in search.
report_reviewed_verify: A reviewer confirmed the posting after your report. That is not a safety promise.
report_reviewed_suppress: A reviewer removed this listing from search.
paste_placeholder: Paste the whole listing: title, employer, location, pay and the description.
paste_saved: Listing saved. It is private to you.
paste_too_short: Paste the full listing (at least {count} characters) so it can be compared with your profile.
paste_bad_url: The link must start with https:// or http://.
remote_not_worldwide: Remote, but the listing does not say where you may work from. Remote does not always mean worldwide.
filter_min_pay_hint: Whole number. Listings that do not state pay are hidden by this filter.
filter_radius_hint: Measured only where the listing and the place both have map coordinates; otherwise the place name must match.
filter_posted_days: {count, plural, one {In the last day} other {In the last # days}}
not_applied_no_place: The distance was not applied: add a place to measure from.
not_applied_geocoding_unavailable: Distance search is not connected yet, so listings were matched by place name instead.
not_applied_place_not_found: That place was not found on the map, so listings were matched by place name instead.
not_applied_no_followed_companies: You do not follow any companies yet, so that filter was not applied.
no_results_filters_body: No stored listing matches these filters. Remove a filter, or paste the vacancy.
paste_category_hint: Choose one if the text does not make it clear. It decides which details are shown.
paste_deadline_hint: Leave empty to read it from the text. Nothing is guessed.
paste_bad_field: Check the category and the deadline date.
track_added: Added to your Job Tracker as saved.
track_already: This listing is already in your Job Tracker.
track_failed: It could not be added. Nothing was created; try again.
prepare_resume: Tailor a résumé for this listing
compare_upgrade_title: Comparisons are not on this plan
compare_upgrade_body: Résumé comparisons start on the {plan} plan. Nothing was used.
compare_upgrade_body_generic: Résumé comparisons need another plan. Nothing was used.
label_reason_skills_overlap: Your confirmed facts cover much of what the listing asks for.
label_reason_little_overlap: Some of what the listing asks for is in your confirmed facts.
label_reason_no_overlap: Little of the listing appears in your confirmed facts yet.
label_reason_credential_missing: A credential the listing requires is not in your confirmed facts.
label_reason_preference_conflict: Something stated in the listing differs from your preferences.
label_reason_expired: The listing has closed or its deadline has passed.
gap_credential: The listing requires {token}, which is not in your confirmed certifications.
preferences_none: Set your preferences in your profile to compare place, schedule, level and pay.
preferences_not_set: {count, plural, one {# preference is not set, so it was not compared.} other {# preferences are not set, so they were not compared.}}
pref_location_meets: Place: {detail} matches a place you would work in.
pref_location_conflict: Place: {detail} is not one of your places.
pref_location_unknown: Place: the listing does not state one.
pref_arrangement_conflict: Work arrangement: {detail}, not one you chose.
pref_seniority_conflict: Level: the title says {detail}, which differs from your level.
pref_pay_unknown: Pay: not stated in a currency and period your minimum can be compared with.
pref_remote_restriction_check: Remote limit: “{detail}”. Check you meet it; FlacronCV does not decide eligibility.
date_hint: Type the digits; the dashes are added for you.
filters_active: {count, plural, one {# filter on} other {# filters on}}
paste_discard_body: The text you pasted has not been saved.
save_failed: The listing was not saved. Try again.
